title: fun-lab: leaderboards

contract.summary: Ranked boards: by XP (alias 'points'), achievements or prizes; all-time on the profile totals, or daily / weekly (from Monday) / monthly on the XP EARNED in the period, read from the event log; per gamed metric; filtered by awardable type; opted-out profiles excluded unless asked; ties broken on profile id; take() and paginate() ranks. A period board with the event log off is refused, never returned empty.

functions.scenario: scenario(input: {clock, config?, subjects, steps}) -> {steps: [{result, events}]}, as in fun-lab/progression. A leaderboard step returns {entries: [LeaderboardEntryResource]} and, when paged, total.

contract.referenceNote: Goldens are laravel-fun-lab's own engine at 0.8.0 or later (period boards on the event log) driven by tests/Conformance/ScenarioRunner.php and written by tests/Conformance/ExportFixturesTest.php. Inputs are authored in fancy-conformance/scripts/fun-lab/leaderboard.input.json.

notes: No discrimination probes, for the reason given in fun-lab/progression.
